limits: Only fixed labels, numeric diagnostics and hashes are exported; no paths, anchors, reading metadata or source content.
CPU resize hits retain undithered Gray8, skip the resize attempt, and still run canvas/final output for completed frames.
Legacy resized_pixels counts completed target pixels even on a CPU hit; it is not a resampling-work counter.
CPU hits, native processed_source_hits, and prepared whole-frame hits are separate observations.
Fresh source-read/hash and receipt lookup/recheck remain required; cancelled partial work is not a completed frame.
Source 32MiB, shared Native/Cpu processed 16MiB, next-frame 32MiB, and planned compute 384MiB budgets do not increase.
Cache residency can increase; retained-cache limits are not peak RSS guarantees and unchanged RSS is not claimed.
n=3 reports independent-process median and range, not p95; OS page cache is uncontrolled.
1500ms is host idle after a completed checkpoint, not fixed input cadence; burst survivors are not all four request latencies.
No physical Kindle, native SEND, ARM ABI runtime, optical grayscale, release-profile timing, or peak RSS measurement is claimed.
